시편 82:1.content: A Psalm of Asaph. God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.

시편 82:2.content: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.

시편 82:3.content: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.

시편 82:4.content: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.

시편 82:5.content: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.

시편 82:6.content: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.

시편 82:7.content: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

시편 82:8.content: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
